symbols.name: forall
symbols.semantics: Universal quantification over explicitly typed bound variables.

symbols.name: exists
symbols.semantics: Existential quantification over explicitly typed bound variables.

symbols.name: type
symbols.semantics: Attaches one exact sort to one bound variable; never a term.

symbols.name: Real
symbols.semantics: Lean ℝ.

symbols.name: RealFunction
symbols.semantics: Lean ℝ → ℝ.

symbols.name: of_int
symbols.semantics: Exact cast of a signed OMI integer literal to ℝ; a bound Nat is converted using of_nat instead.

symbols.name: of_rat
symbols.semantics: Exact rational Real value with reduced numerator and positive nonzero denominator.

symbols.name: lambda
symbols.semantics: Binds exactly one Real variable with a Real body; denotes a real function.

symbols.name: apply
symbols.semantics: apply(f,x) denotes f x.

symbols.name: epsilon_delta_continuous_at
symbols.semantics: The usual positive epsilon/positive delta definition at a; equivalent to ContinuousAt f a.

symbols.name: continuous_at
symbols.semantics: continuous_at(f,a) denotes ContinuousAt f a.

symbols.name: differentiable_at
symbols.semantics: differentiable_at(f,a) denotes DifferentiableAt ℝ f a.

symbols.name: has_deriv_at
symbols.semantics: has_deriv_at(f,point,slope) denotes HasDerivAt f slope point; point precedes slope in OpenMath.

symbols.name: interval_integrable
symbols.semantics: IntervalIntegrable f volume a b, independent of endpoint order.

symbols.name: eq
symbols.semantics: Equality of two terms of exactly the same sort.

symbols.name: neq
symbols.semantics: Negation of equality of two terms of exactly the same sort.

symbols.name: lt
symbols.semantics: Strict real order <.

symbols.name: leq
symbols.semantics: Real order ≤.

symbols.name: gt
symbols.semantics: Strict real order >.

symbols.name: geq
symbols.semantics: Real order ≥.

symbols.name: and
symbols.semantics: Conjunction of all arguments.

symbols.name: or
symbols.semantics: Disjunction of the arguments.

symbols.name: implies
symbols.semantics: Logical implication.

symbols.name: equivalent
symbols.semantics: Logical equivalence.

symbols.name: not
symbols.semantics: Logical negation.

symbols.name: plus
symbols.semantics: Sum of all real arguments.

symbols.name: times
symbols.semantics: Product of all real arguments.

symbols.name: minus
symbols.semantics: Real subtraction.

symbols.name: divide
symbols.semantics: Lean real division; totalized at a zero denominator. Ordinary quotient derivative formulas require nonzero denominator premises.

symbols.name: abs
symbols.semantics: Real absolute value.

symbols.name: unary_minus
symbols.semantics: Real additive inverse.

symbols.name: power
symbols.semantics: Natural-number exponentiation, including x^0=1 and 0^0=1; exponent may be a bound Nat variable.

symbols.name: Nat
symbols.semantics: Lean ℕ, natural numbers including zero.

symbols.name: nat_pred
symbols.semantics: Nat.pred n = n - 1 with subtraction truncated at zero.

symbols.name: nat_succ
symbols.semantics: Nat.succ n = n + 1.

symbols.name: of_nat
symbols.semantics: Canonical natural-number cast into Real.

symbols.name: exp
symbols.semantics: Real.exp on Real.

symbols.name: log
symbols.semantics: Real.log; the real logarithm of absolute value, totalized as Real.log 0 = 0. Derivative cards require nonzero input.

symbols.name: sin
symbols.semantics: Real.sin on Real.

symbols.name: cos
symbols.semantics: Real.cos on Real.

symbols.name: sqrt
symbols.semantics: Real.sqrt; nonnegative square root for nonnegative inputs and zero for negative inputs.

symbols.name: arctan
symbols.semantics: Real.arctan on Real.

symbols.name: continuous
symbols.semantics: Continuous f on all Real.

symbols.name: differentiable
symbols.semantics: Differentiable Real f on all Real.

symbols.name: continuous_on_closed
symbols.semantics: ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b); the closed interval is empty if b<a.

symbols.name: differentiable_on_open
symbols.semantics: DifferentiableOn Real f (Set.Ioo a b).

symbols.name: interval_integral
symbols.semantics: intervalIntegral f a b volume, oriented Bochner interval integral. Totalized by Lean; cards requiring an ordinary finite integral must also carry interval_integrable evidence.

symbols.name: deriv
symbols.semantics: deriv f, a total function returning zero at points where f is not differentiable; use HasDerivAt to assert existence

symbols.name: continuous_on_unordered
symbols.semantics: ContinuousOn f (Set.uIcc a b), including either orientation

symbols.name: continuous_on_image
symbols.semantics: ContinuousOn f (g image Set.uIcc a b); argument order outer function f, image map g, endpoints a,b

symbols.name: uniform_continuous_on_closed
symbols.semantics: UniformContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)

symbols.name: monotone
symbols.semantics: Monotone f on all real numbers

symbols.name: monotone_on_unordered
symbols.semantics: MonotoneOn f (Set.uIcc a b)

symbols.name: strict_monotone_on_closed
symbols.semantics: StrictMonoOn f (Set.Icc a b)

symbols.name: convex
symbols.semantics: ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f, the global real Jensen convexity inequality

symbols.name: strict_convex
symbols.semantics: StrictConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f

symbols.name: local_min
symbols.semantics: IsLocalMin f a in an unrestricted neighborhood, not a constrained minimum

symbols.name: periodic
symbols.semantics: Function.Periodic f T = ∀ x, f(x+T)=f(x); T is any real including zero

symbols.name: limit_right
symbols.semantics: Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin a (Set.Ioi a)) (nhds L); right-hand limit at a equals L

symbols.name: limit_punctured
symbols.semantics: Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ) (nhds L); punctured two-sided limit, no condition on f(a)

symbols.name: limit_at_top
symbols.semantics: Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds L) for a real variable tending to positive infinity

symbols.name: min
symbols.semantics: min a b

symbols.name: max
symbols.semantics: max a b

symbols.name: limit_left
symbols.semantics: Tendsto f (nhdsWithin a (Set.Iio a)) (nhds L); f first, approach point a second, finite real limit L third.

symbols.name: update_value
symbols.semantics: Function.update f a L, equal to L at a and to f elsewhere; does not assert continuity.
